messages:
olivia: FYI I put the release window on hold. CI failing in the integration stage, artifact uploader returns partial/multipart EOF and deploybot is looping on retries.

sanjay: Ugh. Can you paste the uploader logs?

olivia: Sure — snippet below. saw this on bk-agent-12 around 03:12 UTC: 
```
[artifact-uploader] chunk 3/5: write returned EOF
ERROR 2026-03-23T03:12:14Z upload failed: Unexpected EOF while reading
stack: github.com/redwood/artifact/uploader.Upload->multipart.writeChunk
```

rachel: Is this an S3 flake or a runner-side disk issue? :thinking_face:

buildkite-bot: AUTOMATION: job bk-9142 failed (upload step). retries=12, next_backoff=32s.

max: We've seen elevated runner cache evictions in the eu-west pool this morning — might be correlated. I saw GC spikes at ~03:00 UTC.

dan: Do we have a last-known-good artifact digest we can pin to? If we pin, we can manual-promote and avoid missing the change window.

olivia: Last good promoted artifact is from commit 1769401234 — image sha256:abcd1234ef56. If we're going to hit the window (40m), I'd vote pin+promote then follow up.

rachel: +1 for pin and manual promote. We should also add a brief release note entry explaining the pin and follow-up action. :memo:

sanjay: I'll open an infra issue for multipart uploader resilient retries and runner upload chunk sizing. Also triggered a targeted rerun of just the uploader stage (bk-9143) to see if it was transient.

deploy-bot: USER ACTION REQUIRED: manual promote blocked. Run `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1769401234 --reason "ci uploader EOF; hotfix pin"` to proceed.

olivia: I'm going to run that now. Anyone object?

max: No objections. Also please add a TODO to disable the aggressive cache GC in eu-west for the next hour.

olivia: done — manual promote kicked. Command: `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1769401234 --author @olivia`

buildkite-bot: PROMOTE STARTED: canary rollout initiated for release 2026.03.23-hotfix-pin (pinned to sha256:abcd1234ef56).

rachel: I'll draft the release note line: "Hotfix: pinned artifact to last-known-good digest due to intermittent multipart uploader EOF during CI; follow-up investigation opened (infra#4521)."

deploy-bot: PROMOTE SUCCESS: canary deployed. Monitoring started (15m).

olivia: Keeping change window open. Monitoring metrics now — will call for rollback if canary flakiness appears. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
